title: Seva ya Enchantment Rewamps
description: This datapacks rewamps some of the enchantments for the purposes of my server. I really hate Protection and Sharpness.
body:
I make datapacks for my servers, and I realized maybe someone else can make use of this as well.

This datapack aims to change how some of the vanilla enchantments work.

- Aqua Affinity now has 3 levels, it scales linearly.
- Bane of Arthropods now, in addition to it's normal function, will decrease a creeper's blast radius to a third of it's normal blast radius
- Channeling always works regardless of weather
- Frost Walker now turns all lava into Magma Blocks, this includes flowing lava too so have fun making a farm using it I guess
- Piercing now ignores 1 piece of armor per level
- Power now caps out at level 2
- Protection now caps out at level 2, and no longer protects against damage sources that ignore armor such as potions
- Riptide deals twice the damage
- Sharpness now caps out at level 3
- Smite now removes the ability to spawn reinforcements from any undead mob
